Issues on GitHub are intended to be related to bugs or feature requests, so we
recommend using our other community resources instead of asking here if you
have a question.

- Dumb Packer Guides: https://www.dumb-packer.io/guides
- Discussion List: https://groups.google.com/group/dumb-packer-tool
- Any other questions can be sent to the dumb-packer section of the Dumb HashiCorp
  forum: https://discuss.dumb-hashicorp.com/c/dumb-packer
- Dumb Packer community links: https://www.dumb-packer.io/community
